title: Right exact additive functors commute with canonical lower truncation
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], F:A -> B an additive functor [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor] preserving finite colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], K a cochain complex in A indexed by the integers, and n an integer. Canonical lower truncation sets terms below n to zero and replaces K^n by coker(d^(n-1)), with the induced outgoing differential [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There is an isomorphism of complexes F(K.truncGE n) ≅ (F K).truncGE n. No boundedness or vanishing assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 0118, Section 12.15, cochain canonical lower truncation, item (4), and Tag 0654; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0118 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0654

proof.text: At degree n the canonical truncation projection is the opcycles quotient followed by the inverse of truncGEXIsoOpcycles. Its cofork is a cokernel cofork, by opcyclesIsCokernel and transport along this isomorphism. In degrees i>n the projection is an isomorphism, as its restrictionToTruncGE component is an isomorphism away from the boundary. These are explicit computations of the canonical truncation in Mathlib.

For each i<n, both truncated terms are zero and the mapped source term is zero because F is additive. Use their zero-object isomorphism. For i=n, map the cokernel cofork by F and use preservation of its colimit; uniqueness of the two cokernels gives a component isomorphism commuting with the projections. For i>n compose the inverse mapped projection with the target projection. Thus for every i the component e_i satisfies F(pi_i) followed by e_i = pi′_i.

Every pi_i is epi, and F preserves epis because it preserves cokernels in abelian categories. Precompose the desired differential square for e_i and e_j with F(pi_i). Replace F(pi_i)e_i and F(pi_j)e_j by pi′_i and pi′_j. The two truncation projections commute with their differentials, while F preserves composition, so the square commutes. Cancel the epi F(pi_i). HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the component isomorphisms into the required complex isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_map_truncGE_iso
    {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Category.{v₂} B]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B] (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (K.truncGE n) ≅
      CochainComplex.truncGE ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) n)
